name: fathomdb-dev-tooling
description: Repo-wide dev tooling (markdown lint + link check). Not published. The TypeScript binding lives in src/ts/.
comment-scripts: 0.8.9.1: prettier removed from the markdown path (lint:md-format / format:md). prettier's non-configurable *->_ emphasis reflow corrupts fragile markdown (see dev/tools/md-fix-corruption-ledger.md); markdownlint-cli2 --fix via the AST-guarded scripts/md-safe-fix.sh is the safe fixer. prettier kept as a devDependency only for any non-markdown use; remove if unused.
comment-security: 0.8.24 Slice 7: markdownlint-cli2@0.23.2 resolves the audited js-yaml@5.2.2 path, while its markdown-it@14.3.0 resolution carries linkify-it@5.0.2. The offline pin-rot gate prevents a future override from becoming an untracked security exception; advisory provenance is scripts/pinned-override-rot.json.
